scope: new paired sensor-response training/calibration, not original 12-candidate protocol or complete ANS efficacy

feature_contract.cost_scaling: each response descriptor divided by paid route length once
feature_contract.class_source: signed vote of visible RGB marker 2/3, no old shape probability
feature_contract.normal_orientation: measured mean horizontal normal oriented toward retained real camera with most depth-consistent support; zero support disables three oriented channels
feature_contract.novelty_reference: each measured surface point, same origin as its history bits
feature_contract.support_area: 0.15 m voxel count proxy, not true surface area
feature_contract.G_capacity: fixed per-patch squared normalized geometric descriptors, no category

fitting.alpha_selection: leave-one-parent-context-out T only; history mean centered area-rate loss; strongest alpha on ties
fitting.loss: sum of history mean squares plus alpha coefficient squared norm
fitting.max_effective_df: T parent contexts / 2; checked after alpha selection

gates.preparation: same paired nonlabel prefix geometry and G/O/N features; actual X/M remaps; 6 candidates and >=2 marked directional roles
